entities.name: Che Sang Zi Root (Che Sang Zi Gen)

herb_attributes.preparation_method: Used fresh or sun-dried; decoction for internal use; can be stewed with lean pork (broth) or leaves mashed with brown sugar for topical application

formula_attributes.dosage: One to two liang of fresh Che sang zai root, decocted with water for oral administration.
One to two liang of dried Che sang zai root, stewed with lean pork and taken as a broth; fresh leaves mashed with brown sugar and applied topically.
